items.item: Compares lookup and master-detail on sharing, ownership, cascade delete and roll-up summaries
items.evidence: "Roll-up summary fields are the main benefit of master-detail"; "Cascade delete: ... Master-detail forces that cascade"; "Ownership and sharing: Invoices would inherit the Account's sharing and have no owner of their own." Lookup side is covered in the setup section: required lookup with "Don't allow deletion", and DLRS/Flow for roll-ups.

items.item: Raises data skew (more than about 10,000 child records under one parent) and its locking and sharing-recalculation effects
items.evidence: Covers skew and locking: "avoid more than ~10k children per parent"; "locks the parent Account"; "UNABLE_TO_LOCK_ROW". Sharing recalculation effects of skew are not found.

items.item: Gives a recommendation with the reason
items.evidence: "Recommendation: Lookup" with reasons given under "Why master-detail is risky at your volumes"
